      Opportunities

      Explore and eavesdrop to discover ways to reach the target. Press Track on one: a yellow arrow on screen points to its next step and shows how far away it is (it sits on the screen edge when the spot is out of view), and the step is marked 💡 on your map.

      💡 Hint

      Unlocked hints stay free to reopen with H until you finish that step.

      Click an action, then press the key you want. Esc always opens the menu.
